description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_Printer_CSSDefinition` responsible for rendering CSS definitions into HTML formatted output in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for rendering CSS property information in a structured table.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_CSSDefinition
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering CSS definitions as HTML, specifically for displaying CSS property information in a tabular format within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates HTML output presenting the CSS properties and their definitions in a table format, using the provided configuration object to retrieve the CSS definitions.
